beats.headline: HE NEVER FIRED A SHOT
beats.text: He never fired a shot. What he supplied was rarer: a cover story.

beats.headline: TWO BOYS, ONE SCHOOL
beats.text: It began with two boys at a military school in Punjab.

beats.headline: THE COVER
beats.text: One ran an immigration business. The other used its Mumbai office to scout targets.

beats.headline: THE SPLIT VERDICT
beats.text: An American jury: not guilty of Mumbai. Guilty of supporting the group behind it.

beats.headline: THE LOOPHOLE
beats.text: Same events. Different crimes. And that gap brought him to Delhi.

beats.headline: THE FRONT MAN
beats.text: The Front Man. Now on The Sisodia Files.
